description:
What the gateway does with budgeted traffic while it cannot deliver usage to the control plane, whose spend counters are what mark a budget exhausted.

At most one document exists per environment, keyed by the environment id. Without it the gateway behaves as `sticky`.

closed_grace_seconds.description: How long usage delivery may fail before `closed` starts rejecting budgeted traffic, in seconds.

fail_mode.description: `sticky` keeps enforcing the last exhausted state the gateway received and lets everything else through. `closed` additionally rejects budgeted traffic once usage delivery has failed for `closed_grace_seconds`: a request from an API key that at least one budget applies to is answered `503 budget_unverified`, and an upstream whose provider key has a budget is not used.

title: BudgetPolicy
